subject: BlueCrest: CAIQ proofchain & assertion log request
messages:
From: Claire Sun <claire@bluecrest-audit.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: caiq@bluecrest-audit.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueCrest CAIQ evidence: request for assertion log and provenance

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our CAIQ review for BlueCrest Financial we need a consolidated assertion log (CSV or spreadsheet) that lists Redwood's control assertions mapped to the CAIQ questions, plus a "proofchain" (artifact provenance) for each assertion. Specifically we need: 

- A row-per-assertion export that includes: control id (CAIQ/CCM id), assertion text, owner, evidence artifact id(s), and timestamps for when the artifact was created/collected.
- Proofchain entries that show how an artifact maps to runtime telemetry (e.g., log sample id, S3 object name, checksum) — we want to be able to validate provenance programmatically.
- Sample runtime logs for the following controls: data isolation (CCM-DS-01), key rotation & KMS usage (CCM-CR-02), and telemetry retention (CCM-TL-03). We only need 30 days of samples (Mar–May 2027) and low-sensitivity snippets (redacted).

Can you confirm owners and an ETA for a first delivery? If possible, include a short MD5 or SHA-256 checksum for each evidence artifact and a quick note on access method (Drive link / S3 presigned URL / Jira attachment).

Thanks,
Claire
BlueCrest Security

Thanks Mateo — I've started a proofchain manifest and pulled samples for the requested controls. Notes so far:

- Proofchain manifest (attached stub) includes: artifact_id, artifact_type, storage_path, sha256, collected_at, collector_process_id. I'll expand artifact_type to include "runtime-log-sample" and "kafka-telemetry-snapshot".
- For telemetry retention (CCM-TL-03) I extracted a 30-day window of aggregated trace ids; the sample set is redacted and stored as S3 objects: s3://redwood-sec-samples/bluecrest/ccm-tl03/sample-xxxx.tar.gz.
- KMS/key rotation evidence: Kimberly, Priya — can you confirm rotation events and provide the rotation-policy doc version + HSM attestation if available? BlueCrest wants a string we can surface in the CSV under "evidence_notes" (e.g., "KMS rotation v1.4; HSM attest v2.0; artifact id kms-rot-20270516").

Drive link (working folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Redwood-CAIQ-BlueCrest — I placed the proofchain_manifest.json and a README describing artifact naming conventions.

Attachment: proofchain_manifest.json (stub)

On blockers: we need a short-term presign policy to share non-sensitive S3 samples with BlueCrest; security is fine with presigned URLs if we limit TTL to 72 hours.

-Marissa
